blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY — A combined team from the police and military raided a warehouse in San Simon, Pampanga on Oct. 12, arresting two Chinese men allegedly storing and selling P1.2 million worth of unregistered laundry fabric softeners. In a statement, the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) said its operatives from the National Capital Region field unit, alongside the Philippine Air Force, Military Intelligence Unit, and the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), served a search warrant at a warehouse in Barangay San Isidro for alleged violation of the Food, Drug and Cosmetic Act and the FDA Act of 2009.
